Two Sentenced to Death in Meerut Blue Drum Murder Case

A court in Meerut has sentenced Muskan and Sahil to death for the murder of Saurabh Rajput, an incident referred to as the 'blue drum murder case'. The court deemed the crime heinous. Saurabh Rajput's mother has also made a statement regarding the sentencing.
